3. LiveReview - Free, Risk-Aware Code Review: Auto Approve Low-Risk Changes
   - Description: Most AI review tools flag issues. LiveReview promises production results: fewer incidents, fewer rollbacks, less senior reviewer load. Every PR is risk-scored. The lowest-risk 30-50% are safely auto-approved; the risky ones go straight to the engineers who should see them. The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. Free and self-hostable.

We do have customization for increasing the importance of various dimensions such as correctness, security, performance, cloud costs, etc.

You can also specify employee levels, so interns, etc always get reviewed (until their level increases).

We are also planning "keyword based" assignment -- so if particular trigger words there it'll goto reviewers.

But if you're thinking some other way of doing this -- let me know, happy to support.

@agshin_rajabovThanks Agshin, for engaging!

Short answer: Yes, the size of the code is only one of the signals we use. We have blast radius analysis based on AST, production feedback, keywords, approval levels and such things to make it more intelligent.

On top of that -- the ML system can learn over time from production behaviors (incidents, rollback) to know which parts of code are tricky, etc as well.

The thing is -- over time -- the system level performance will improve -- lower downtime, reduced incidents, rollbacks, etc. So we aim for that.
